To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the insulin receptor substrate 1 (IRS-1) is not required for insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1)-stimulated activation of the Ras/mitogen-activated protein kinase pathway, but it is required for IGF1-stimulated induction of early gene transcription and S-phase progression.
the Gab-1 protein can substitute for the insulin receptor substrate proteins to regulate IGF-1 signaling in IRS-1 null cells.
IRS-1 and Gab-1 are both capable of regulating IGF-1 signaling in IRS-1 null 3T3 fibroblasts.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of the insulin receptor substrate ( IRS)-1 in the regulation of insulin/insulin-like growth factor- (IGF-)1 signaling in 3T3 fibroblasts and the role of the newly discovered IRS family member, Gab-1 in the regulation insulin and IGF-1 signaling in IRS-1 deficient 3T3 cells.
the role of Gab-1 and its potential as a target for the development of novel therapeutics for the treatment of type II diabetes and obesity.
the role of the insulin receptor substrate ( IRS) family of proteins in the regulation of insulin and IGF-1 signaling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the IRS-1/Gab-1 pathway is the main pathway of the IGF-1 signaling in the IRS-1 deficient fibroblasts.
Gab-1 is able to mediate IGF-1 signaling in IRS-1 deficient fibroblasts, but that it is not able to do so in a tyrosine phosphorylated state.
Gab-1 is a novel IRS-1 independent mediator of IGF- 1 signaling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Gab-1 can be a mediator for insulin/IGF signaling in the absence of IRS-1.
the Gab1 protein can mediate insulin and IGF-1 signaling in the absence of tyrosine phosphorylataion.
Gab-1 is a new member of the IRS family of proteins that can function in the absence of IRS-1 and that can mediate IGF-1 signaling in a manner independent of its direct tyrosine-phosphorylation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Gab-1 is a key mediator of IGF-2-stimulated mitogenesis and early gene expression in IRS-2-deficient cells and that Gab-1-mediated signaling is independent of direct tyrosine kinase phosphorylation.
the insulin and IGF-1 receptors are capable of stimulating mitogenic and metabolic effects through IRS proteins and also through a novel pathway involving Gab-1.
Gab-1 can functionally replace IRS-1 in mediating IGF-1-induced cell cycle progression and immediate early gene expression in IRS- 1-deficient fibrobasts.
